# MoyaForge UI documentation

This directory owns the documentation and interactive examples for installable
components in `packages/moyaforge-ui/src/components/`.

The playground discovers the `ui` content source from
`apps/playground/registry.config.ts` and renders these MDX pages using the
canonical workspace UI source. New `01-components/01-code-block/page.mdx`-style pages become
routable without adding application routes. Numeric folder prefixes determine sibling ordering and are stripped from public URLs and displayed labels; for example, `01-components/01-code-block/page.mdx` resolves to `/ui/components/code-block`.

Component documentation should provide a working preview, usage, installation,
relevant variations and accessibility guidance. Import canonical component source
through the MDX provider (or directly within the MDX page); do not create
duplicate implementations inside `apps/playground`.

Component registry entries live in the generated root `registry.json` and
their source remains in `src/components`. This docs directory is not part
of the installable component source graph.

## UI Components

These examples use the canonical source in `packages/moyaforge-ui/src/components/`.
Components are installed individually through the MoyaForge component registry;
they are not bundled into the framework package.

### Component demonstrations

- [Code Block](/ui/components/code-block) — live MDX code blocks with copy actions.
- [Code Group](/ui/components/code-group) — interactive command tabs.
- [Copy Button](/ui/components/copy-button) — clipboard feedback.
- [Source](/ui/components/source) — source rendering.
- [Demo](/ui/components/demo) — composable previews.
- [Empty State](/ui/components/empty-state) — informative empty views.
- [Page](/ui/components/page) — semantic content wrapper.
- [Edit Page Link](/ui/components/edit-page-link) — repository edit links.
- [Navigation Tree](/ui/components/navigation-tree) — nested documentation navigation.
- [Search](/ui/components/search) — searchable input primitive.
- [Doc Outline](/ui/components/doc-outline) — scroll-aware heading navigation.
- [Table of Contents](/ui/components/table-of-contents) — heading links.
- [Sidebar V1](/ui/components/sidebar-v1) — page-driven navigation.
- [Sidebar V2](/ui/components/sidebar-v2) — composable sidebar primitives.
- [Docs Layout](/ui/components/docs-layout) — slot-based documentation layout.
- [Documentation Site](/ui/components/documentation-site) — standalone documentation chrome.
- [Docs Shell](/ui/components/docs-shell) — editable layout template.
- [Docs Shell Focused](/ui/components/docs-shell-focused) — focused reading layout.
- [Docs Shell Wide](/ui/components/docs-shell-wide) — workspace layout with optional slots.
- [Monaco Editor React](/ui/components/monaco-editor-react) and [Monaco Editor TypeFox](/ui/components/monaco-editor-typefox) — pluggable multi-file editor.

More components will be added here using the same pattern. Every page is discovered
from this directory by the playground's MDX registry, without manually creating routes.
